description: 电商问数评测集 v1.1（50 用例：40 问数 + 10 default）。标注口径：columns=meta.column_info.id 全名；metrics=metric_info.name；values=ES 已索引真实取值。情景覆盖：时间粒度（年/季/月/日）、地区/客户/商品维度、分组排行、TopN、组合条件、派生指标、空结果风险、default 兜底与数字词干扰例。

cases.query: 华北地区2025年第一季度的GMV是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1'

cases.query: 2025年全年的总订单数是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025

cases.query: 2025年3月的销售额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 3

cases.query: 统计2025年第二季度的总销量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q2'

cases.query: 2025年5月15日当天有多少订单
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo WHERE fo.date_id = 20250515

cases.query: 2025年的平均订单金额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS aov FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025

cases.query: 查一下最小的单笔订单金额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT MIN(fo.order_amount) AS min_amount FROM fact_order fo

cases.query: 华东地区2025年的销售额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华东' AND fo.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231

cases.query: 东北地区2025年第三季度的订单量有多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '东北' AND dd.quarter = 'Q3'

cases.query: 广东省的订单总数是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.province = '广东省'

cases.query: 西南地区2025年各季度的销售额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dd.quarter AS quarter, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '西南' GROUP BY dd.quarter ORDER BY dd.quarter

cases.query: 华北和华东2025年的GMV分别是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dr.region_name AS region_name, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.region_name IN ('华北', '华东') GROUP BY dr.region_name

cases.query: 黄金会员2025年的总消费金额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS spend FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE dc.member_level = '黄金'

cases.query: 女性客户的订单数有多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE dc.gender = '女'

cases.query: 白银会员的平均订单金额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS aov FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE dc.member_level = '白银'

cases.query: 各会员等级的订单数排行
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dc.member_level AS member_level, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY dc.member_level ORDER BY orders DESC

cases.query: 铂金会员2025年第一季度的消费总额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS spend FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dc.member_level = '铂金' AND dd.quarter = 'Q1'

cases.query: 苹果品牌2025年的总销量是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '苹果'

cases.query: 手机数码品类2025年的销售额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.category = '手机数码'

cases.query: 各品类的销量排行
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dp.category AS category, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id GROUP BY dp.category ORDER BY quantity DESC

cases.query: 海尔品牌的平均订单金额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(fo.order_amount) AS aov FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '海尔'

cases.query: 销售额排名前5的品牌有哪些
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dp.brand AS brand, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id GROUP BY dp.brand ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5

cases.query: 美妆个护品类2025年第二季度的订单量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dp.category = '美妆个护' AND dd.quarter = 'Q2'

cases.query: 2025年每个月的订单数趋势
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dd.month AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 GROUP BY dd.month ORDER BY dd.month

cases.query: 每个季度的销售额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dd.quarter AS quarter, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id GROUP BY dd.quarter ORDER BY dd.quarter

cases.query: 销量最高的5个商品是哪些
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dp.product_name AS product_name, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id GROUP BY dp.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 5

cases.query: 销售额最低的3个地区
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dr.region_name AS region_name, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id GROUP BY dr.region_name ORDER BY sales ASC LIMIT 3

cases.query: 华东地区女性客户2025年的订单数
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dc.gender = '女' AND dr.region_name = '华东'

cases.query: 黄金会员在手机数码品类的消费金额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS spend FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dc.member_level = '黄金' AND dp.category = '手机数码'

cases.query: 2025年第四季度华北地区各品类的销量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dp.category AS category, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND dd.quarter = 'Q4' GROUP BY dp.category ORDER BY quantity DESC

cases.query: 耐克品牌在华东地区的销售额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dp.brand = '耐克' AND dr.region_name = '华东'

cases.query: 平均每个订单包含多少件商品
